case_title: State (NCT of Delhi) vs. Aman Verma
facts: Accused alleged to have set up an illegal call center defrauding foreign nationals through remote-desktop trojans. Investigating Officer submitted that FSL cyber forensic analysis of seized laptops is pending and foreign server logs are awaited.

case_title: Sunil R. Deshmukh vs. State of Maharashtra
facts: Allegations of financial fraud regarding non-delivery of premium commercial real estate units. Defense counsel repeatedly sought adjournments on four successive dates citing medical emergency of senior advocate.

case_title: State of Karnataka vs. Ramesh Gowda & Ors.
facts: Armed highway robbery of electronic consignment. Primary prosecution eye-witness and panch witnesses failed to appear before trial court despite bailable warrants issued on three consecutive dates.

case_title: Priyanka Saxena vs. State of Uttar Pradesh
facts: Allegation of bogus educational society trust clearance. Certified copies of revenue circle entries and vernacular translation of registry deeds pending submission by prosecution since six months.

case_title: State of West Bengal vs. Tanmoy Mukherjee
facts: Compromise of state electricity payment gateway. Co-accused granted bail on ground of clean antecedents and Section 41A CrPC notice compliance; applicant claims parity on identical factual footing.

case_title: Hitesh J. Patel vs. State of Gujarat
facts: Cooperative bank credit facility default case. Matter proceeded expeditiously; preliminary charge-sheet filed and arguments heard on bail merits without procedural delays.

case_title: State of Punjab vs. Gurpreet Singh Sandhu
facts: Snatching and robbery charge. Investigating agency sought repeated adjournments as the ballistic and fingerprint identification records could not be retrieved from regional laboratory.

case_title: State of Rajasthan vs. Meena Kumari
facts: Government recruitment examination paper leakage and fake admit cards. Police submitted supplementary charge-sheet is pending as main kingpin is still absconding.

case_title: Muhammed Shafi vs. State of Kerala
facts: Identity theft and unauthorized digital surveillance. Complainant was not available during scheduled cross examination; summons returned unserved due to changed address.

case_title: State of MP vs. Kailash Chandra Joshi
facts: Theft of municipal water pipeline fittings. Normal court listing without any specific procedural or witness delays recorded on the order sheet.

case_title: State of Bihar vs. Santosh Yadav
facts: State moved application for cancellation of bail previously granted, alleging threatening of prosecution witnesses and violation of bail bond conditions.

case_title: Subhashree Mohanty vs. State of Odisha
facts: Cryptocurrency investment scheme fraud. The bank nodal officer and cyber nodal witness were repeatedly summoned but failed to attend hearings.
